title: Red Hat Security Advisory: python3.12 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: A race condition vulnerability in Python 3.12 used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 allows arbitrary file deletion during temporary directory cleanup. This issue is tracked as CVE-2026-12345 and has been rated as moderate severity by Red Hat. An update to python3.12 is available that addresses this security flaw along with other bug fixes and enhancements.
